title: Middle of the Linked List
description: Given the `head` of a singly linked list represented as an array of values, return the middle node and all subsequent nodes. If there are two middle nodes, return the second middle node.

hints.content: Fast pointer moves twice as fast as slow pointer.
When fast reaches the end, slow is at the middle. For array, slice from Math.floor(len / 2).

solution.explanation:
Finding middle index via two pointers or Math.floor(n / 2).
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(n)
